patch.value: pm aggregate: explicit (unassigned)/(none) labels for blank group keys in all output modes (GH-225)

When --group-by assignee (or any nullable dimension) yields a null/blank key, render an explicit (unassigned)/(none) label in terminal and any CSV/JSON-friendly output so it is grep-friendly and unambiguous. JSON keeps null in the structured group value; the display label is explicit.
pm aggregate rows now carry explicit group_label ((unassigned)/(untagged)/(unparented); multi-field joins field=value) while structured group keeps raw null. Verified. Closes GH-225.
